events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Michael Philip Jagger, known as the lead singer of The Rolling Stones, was born on July 26, 1943.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Icon
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still strutting! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legendary Mick Jagger. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: MTV: Music Television went on air for the first time on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first video.

angles.name: Video Killed The Radio Star
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV changed music forever. Remember watching the very first video? What was your favourite music video from back in the day?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 years on
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music and Art Fair, billed as '3 Days of Peace & Music', began on August 15, 1969, on Max Yasgur's dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off. An unforgettable moment in music history. Which artist would you have loved to see there?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977; he would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and legend live on. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon and frontwoman of The Pretenders. What's your favourite track from her?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher, best known as the frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Mad For It Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid's turning 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo tune?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 and decades of iconic films, gadgets, and unforgettable theme tunes. What's your favourite Bond moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the iconic singer-songwriter and member of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Imagine His Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy. What's your favourite sketch or character?
